announcements.headline: EQS-News: aap increases revenue by 2% in the third quarter of 2026 – on top of the already high prior-year level
announcements.insight: aap increases revenue by 2% in Q3 2026. This follows H1 profitability improvements and a focus on the trauma business.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: aap Implantate AG: Focus on the trauma business – fully MDR-certified portfolio, new products, expanded sales activities – capital increase to finance the next phase of growth
announcements.insight: Following the August CEO change, a capital increase finances growth in the trauma business. This strategic shift follows recent profitability improvements.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: aap Implantate AG: Appointment of new board members and change of CEO at aap Implantate AG
announcements.insight: The CEO departure follows the H1 2026 profitability improvement. Shareholders should watch for strategic direction under new board leadership.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: aap improves profitability in the first half of 2026 and starts the second half of the year with record order intake
announcements.insight: AAP Implantate Ag reports improved profitability in H1 2026 and record order intake. This suggests strong operational momentum for shareholders.
